broken_selectors: The selector `button:has-text("Login")` is dependent on text content which can break during internationalization (i18n). Use `button[type="submit"]` instead.
Redundant clicks on input elements prior to typing (`input[name="username"]`, `input[name="password"]`) can be removed in automated tests.
missing_validations: Validation for account lockout policy after multiple failed login attempts.
Inline validation messages checking for required fields when input fields are left blank.
Assertion verifying the error toast alert element when invalid credentials are provided.
recommendations: Add `data-testid` attributes to username, password inputs, and the submit button for stronger automation reliability.
Ensure API status code 401 response handling is validated on failed auth requests.
Implement automated state reset or clear input actions between retry attempts in automated scripts.
